plan: Given my private value of $28, I aim to bid just above the expected average bid of the other bidders to maximize profit. Assuming rational behavior, the average expected bid is around half the maximum value, $24.5. To win, I should bid slightly higher, but below my value to ensure profit if I win. A bid of $25.5 balances winning probability and profit margin, as it is above the average but below my value.

Given my value of $23, I aim to bid slightly below my value to potentially secure a profit. Assuming Andy and Charles are rational, they might bid close to their values. To maximize profit, I'll bid $22. This ensures I win if their bids are below $22 and pay the third-highest bid, maximizing my net gain.

Given my value of $36, I aim to win while ensuring my profit (value minus payment) is maximized. Other bidders have values between $0 and $49. I expect rational bids near their values.
